plan.question: For q6, q7 and q12, how do exact WMMA/scalar outputs change when A is scaled by2^e and B by2^-e, preserving each term product and reference across e=-2 through2?

estimands.primary: Retain all45 parameter-condition outcomes separately for each variant and execution order.
estimands.reciprocal_curve: Retain exact dyadic references, signed/absolute residuals and adjacent-FP32 distances for each q/A-exponent/B-exponent/role; no output equality or monotonicity is imposed.
estimands.exponent_comparisons: Compare complete output buffers across all reciprocal exponents within q/role, retaining different operands and any output differences.
estimands.matched_components: Retain each pair beside its matching reciprocal standalone controls and exact CPU sums of observed components; these are derived CPU relations, not executed GPU additions.

plan.historical_match_scope: all45 prior scale primary conditions, retaining every complete actual A/B uint16 match including input aliases
plan.trace_selection: Exactly q07-am2-bp2-pair, q07-a0-b0-pair and q07-ap2-bm2-pair were selected before execution; each paired trace is WMMA-first.
plan.acceptance: Retain complete numerical failure with the exact oracle unchanged. Structural, input-snapshot or guard corruption stops subsequent stages. No performance acceptance or predetermined scalar/WMMA outcome.
limitations: This finite reciprocal grid does not identify a global rule, a unique arithmetic cause or inherited behavior from one-sided scaling.
Complete-buffer equality across mathematical equivalents and input aliases remains an observed comparison, not an acceptance requirement.
All historical matching rows are retained; multiple links from one current output are not independent output observations.
Three input snapshots establish capture-boundary equality only, not transient values inside a kernel.
Source-level scalar operations are not a forced ISA implementation; unchanged kernel bodies do not establish unchanged binaries.
Eight prior suites remain auxiliary observations. Three selected q7 pair traces do not profile all45 conditions. No accepted timings or speedup ratios.

correctness.analysis_scope: complete frozen checker replay of actual prepared inputs, snapshots and outputs; additional nominated-cell, support-position and repeated-buffer observations
correctness.expected_launch_count_scope: sum of frozen per-variant declarations; not a profiler count for every unprofiled launch

measurement.scope: raw complete-kernel timings retained for provenance only, not speedup, throughput or accepted performance

integrity.guard_scope: all paired outputs and three snapshots checked by complete checker

protocol.comparison: finite exact numeric equality; signed zero equivalent; no tolerance
protocol.timed_scope: default-stream events around 10 full tile launches; may include host submission gaps
protocol.transfer_scope: CPU packing, allocation, H2D/D2H copies, reset, attribute queries and file writes excluded
protocol.cache_policy: repeated addresses; no explicit application cache reset; runtime cache policy unknown
protocol.interpretation: descriptive full tile kernel; no native-instruction throughput or end-to-end GEMM claim
protocol.pointer_alignment_scope: largest power of two dividing each observed device address; no imported alignment requirement
protocol.scalar_source_scope: float operands and accumulator; compiler contraction and emitted instructions are not prescribed
protocol.scale_rule: only A is multiplied by 2^scale_exp from its base numerator/16; B is unchanged; all other input words are positive zero
protocol.standalone_inactive_slot_policy: both A and B are positive zero at the inactive K slot
protocol.baseline_scope: matching_magnitude_pattern compares complete declared operand words, including cross-scale matches; actual historical equality must be checked separately

admission.release_boundary: probe process exit after device synchronization and output retention

cache.scope: file-list observations; file creation is not a compilation count and absence is not proof of no compilation

retained_check_metadata.input_observation_scope: before/between/after capture boundaries only; no assertion about transient values inside a kernel
retained_check_metadata.tested_contract: same packed operands at before/between/after snapshots; both full256 FP32 outputs finite and exact to the declared dyadic rational reference, signed zeros equivalent; all guards intact
retained_check_metadata.timing_scope: descriptive per-variant batches; no speedup or performance acceptance

checker.replay_scope: complete check_control replay from the exact frozen source; retained JSON matches every field before adding actual word projections

limitations: The finite reciprocal grid does not identify a global threshold, monotonicity, inherited one-sided-scaling behavior or a unique hardware/compiler/SDK arithmetic cause.

A and B use reciprocal powers of two, preserving each exact term product and reference within q/role. Actual complete-buffer equality, passing outcomes and equal, symmetric or additive errors are not imposed.
Each primary pattern separately retains C00 and all other 255 expected-zero outputs.
Prepared inputs and three snapshots prove equality only at capture boundaries, not transient kernel inputs.
Scalar-source float operations do not establish a forced ISA sequence or prohibit contraction; unchanged kernel bodies do not establish unchanged emitted binaries.
Historical whole-buffer comparisons require matching operand contracts, not just matching dimensions; primary matches and within-sweep aliases are discovered from complete actual operand arrays.
All exact-contract failures remain failures. A passing primary pattern does not erase failed regression observations, and no tolerance or performance acceptance is introduced.
All eight auxiliary suites, unprofiled reciprocal sweeps and three selected q7 pair profiles remain separately identified; no full-grid profiler coverage.
One C550/native software stack with bounded deterministic packed FP16 operands, initially zero accumulator and one 16x16 output tile; no arbitrary-input or framework GEMM qualification.
